It's as enchanting inside as it is on the outside. Marble pillars support the upper floor and the lanterns attached to them. The walls are swarming with photographs, some of what undoubtedly must be famous people and others of happy customers..

The tavern itself is packed. Workers seem to be the primary clientele here, which could be seen as the best sign you can get. Several long tables are occupied by happy, excited groups of people, some are dancing on the table, while others cheer them on with clapping and yelling. The other, smaller tables are also occupied by people who are singing and dancing, occassionaly pulling an unsuspecting waitress amidst their dancing group. Even most of the stools at the bar are occupied, though nobody seems to mind more company.

You did hear rumors about this tavern, supposedly it's famous for something, but you can't remember what for. Though judging by the amount of men staring at one of the waitresses, it's probably her beauty and charm. You manage to find a seat and prepare for what will undoubtedbly be a great evening.

name: Towns
samples: Established on the Eastern side of a  jungle, the village of Zandalur is home to trolls lead by Marshal Jaafan.
This village wasn't built by a jungle by accident, as it has old tombs, which is of great importance to the people of Zandalur and its success.
The village itself looks stunning. With its ceramic tile rooftops, ceramic tile walls and the native bird species, Zandalur has a glamorous atmosphere.
The main attraction is the tombs, which was built 65 years ago and designed by dwarves.
Zandalur has an advancing economy, which is mainly supported by carpenting, crafting and thieving. But their biggest strengths are master engineering and skilled fighters.
However, Zandalur lacks people skilled in beer brewing.
Despite its strengths and weaknesses, Zandalur is most likely headed towards a delightful future under the leadership of Marshal Jaafan. But this remains to be seen.
Fabricated inside a  lake, the port of Gandoline is home to dark elves lead by Sergeant Ninleyn.
This port wasn't built by a lake by accident, as it has healing properties, which is of great importance to the people of Gandoline and its success.
The port itself looks macabre. With its rusted rooftops, lavastone walls and dirty roads, Gandoline has a repulsive atmosphere.
The main attraction is the dueling arena, which was built 32 years ago and designed by trolls.
Gandoline has an improving economy, which is mainly supported by tailoring, armorsmithing and weaponsmithing. But their biggest strengths are rare animal breeding and alchemy.
However, Gandoline lacks people skilled in trade.
Despite its strengths and weaknesses, Gandoline is most likely headed towards a somber future under the leadership of Sergeant Ninleyn. But this remains to be seen.
Settled on the Western side of a  woodlands, the megalopolis of Pitmerden is home to humans lead by Lord Lamkin.
This megalopolis wasn't built by a woodlands by accident, as it has a broken, hidden library, which is of great importance to the people of Pitmerden and its success.
The megalopolis itself looks graceful. With its ebony wood rooftops, maple wood walls and rainbow of different flowers, Pitmerden has a enchanting atmosphere.
The main attraction is the hospital, which was built 25 years ago and designed by barbarians.
Pitmerden has a declining economy, which is mainly supported by beer brewing, weaponsmithing and leatherworking. But their biggest strengths are strong magicians and refined baking.
However, Pitmerden lacks people skilled in carpenting.
Despite its strengths and weaknesses, Pitmerden is most likely headed towards a booming future under the leadership of Lord Lamkin. But this remains to be seen.

name: Traditions
samples: In the remote town of Xethium it is tradition for men to create a traditional work of art on the winter solstice. It's supposed to be a symbol of compassion and discipline and it's usually part of a type of honoring ritual that can last for an entire week.
In the territory of Dupresh it is tradition to kiss the hands of a new born baby. It's supposed to bless the lives of all those around the baby.

In the country of Gastyae it is tradition for people to throw sugar on the streets once every six months. It's supposed to be a symbol of trust and intelligence and it's usually part of a religious ritual or festivity that can last for days.
In the territory of Pedros it is tradition to cover the eyes, ears and mouths of the deceased. It's supposed to prevent the spirit of the deceased from trying to return.

In the area of Bablington it is tradition for people to hack old furniture to pieces on the summer solstice. It's supposed to be a symbol of charm and intelligence and it's usually part of a larger ceremony that can last for a day or two.
In the country of Gadron it is tradition to gift a new born baby an item of the oldest living person in the family. It's supposed to bless the baby and bring it fortune and health.

name: Wands
samples: This wand is made out of Medlar Wood, which heavily prefers owners with an affinity for enchantments. The handle is made out of Spruce Wood, which in turn tends to prefer those with strength and agility. However, the combination of this strand of Medlar Wood and Spruce Wood means the wand will seek out somebody who tends to make the right choice.

A wand usually has 1 or 2 cores, but some have 3, this wand has 3 cores. A core of wolf heartstring which aids with casting spells at greater speeds and ghost hair is added to regulate the power of the wolf heartstring core. Finally, a core of pegasus feather is added in small amounts to enhances the owner's courage, especially in dire situations.

The wand measures 13 inches/33 cm and has an antique look. The particular strand of Medlar Wood used in this wand is not very common, which does add to the overall cost of the wand, however wolf heartstring is quite common,  resulting in a reasonably inexpensive wand.

The handle is made out of Senna Wood, which in turn heavily favors those with an affinity for spoken magics. However, the combination of this strand of Hornbeam Wood and Senna Wood means the wand will seek out somebody with a strong sense of justice.
A wand usually has 1 or 2 cores, but some have 3, this wand has 1 core. A core of troll whisker which has the ability to calm its owner in dire situations.

The wand measures 9 inches/23 cm and has a gilded handle. The particular strand of Hornbeam Wood used in this wand is quite rare, which increases the production cost of the wand and troll whisker is not very common as well,  resulting in a fancy wand for an extravagant price.

This wand is made out of Cycad Wood, which tends to prefer those with strength and agility. The handle is made out of Mangrove Wood, which in turn usually prefers those bound by honor and integrity. However, the combination of this strand of Cycad Wood and Mangrove Wood means the wand will seek out somebody who tends to make the right choice.

A wand usually has 1 or 2 cores, but some have 3, this wand has 3 cores. A core of centaur hoof shavings which tends to add explosiveness in various forms to spells and stardust is added to boost the power of the centaur hoof shavings core. Finally, a core of hippogriff claw is added in small amounts to strengthens the wand and protects against magical damage.

The wand measures 11 inches/28 cm and has a classy look. The particular strand of Cycad Wood used in this wand is quite ordinary, which means the price of the wand won't be too high and centaur hoof shavings is very common as well,  resulting in a very cheap wand.

name: Weapons
samples: A long, thin, curved blade made of copper is held by a grip wrapped in low-cost, green wolf leather.
With just one razor-sharp edge this weapon will protect you from incoming blows while also giving you the ability to shred your enemies to pieces.

The blade has a narrow, twisted cross-guard, adding weight to the blade for a better weight balance, as well as offering hand protection during battle. The cross-guard has an elegant claw on each side, this weapon was clearly a custom order, probably by an important figure.
A wide pommel is  marked with the symbol of its owner, this weapon is clearly meant for an important figure.
The blade itself is bare. No decorations or engraved patterns. While the hilt is as elegant as its owner, the blade has to be as strong as its owner.
This weapon is used by the royal guard. Worn by the wealthiest among us, but not always the most deserving among us.
A short, narrow, jagged blade made of silver is held by a grip wrapped in gilded, grey boar hide.
With a point as sharp as a razor this weapon is the ideal choice to turn your enemies into Swiss cheese.
The blade has a broad, twisted cross-guard, offering plenty of protection to the owner's hands and thus his or her life. The cross-guard has a plain coil on each side, a sign of mass production.
A wide pommel is  engraved with the sword maker's symbol, an unimpressive symbol at the best of times.
The blade itself is simple. No decorations or engraved patterns, any engravings could only diminish the strength of the blade.
This weapon is used by the royal guard. Worn by the wealthiest among us, but not always the most deserving among us.
A fairly large, thin, jagged blade made of folded steel is held by a grip wrapped in common, ruby red salmon leather.
A fine, sharp point makes this weapon a perfect choice if you wish to puncture your enemies to death with ruthless speed and precision.

The blade has a spiked, straight cross-guard, adding just enough weight to make sure the blade sits firmly in the owner's hand and protecting those same hands as well. The cross-guard has a decorative dragon tail on each side, the cost of this weapon must have been high.
A massive pommel is  engraved with the sword maker's signature, a symbol one can be proud of.
The blade itself is bare. No markings can be found, but the blade will surely be decorated in battle.
This weapon is used by the royal guard. None deserve this weapon more than the greatest fighters of all.
